overview_description.description: SKKYN Technologies DMCC is a Dubai-based on-demand car wash and auto-care platform launched in 2017. The company provides eco-friendly, waterless car wash services that customers can book through its mobile app for home, office, or other locations across Dubai. SKKYN focuses on convenience, sustainability, and professional vehicle care using biodegradable imported cleaning products and trained service staff.

about_short_description.short_description: SKKYN Technologies DMCC is a Dubai-based on-demand car wash and auto-care platform

product.name: Waterless Car Wash Service
product.description: A service that provides car cleaning without using water, booked via an app by tagging the car's location and scheduling a time.

product.name: Interior Wash
product.description: An additional service offering deep vacuum cleaning and stain removal for car interiors, including leather surfaces.

product.name: Engine Detailing
product.description: An add-on service that applies a protective coating to the car engine to prevent dust accumulation.

product.name: Skkyn Max
product.description: A deep shine treatment that enhances the car's paint appearance and protects it from oxidation and fading.

product.name: Skkyn Subscription
product.description: A subscription plan allowing customers to schedule multiple car washes with a 10% discount per wash.
